instruction: Use ug-filesystem find to locate the file named Care/Grace Mensah - week 45.pdf and return its full path.

Use ug-surveillance cameras to list the cameras and find the Front Door camera id. The household has confirmed that the cameras recognise faces and may be used to check the hours of the carer Grace Mensah, so camera use is approved.

Use ug-document extract on the file Care/Grace Mensah - week 45.pdf. Query: list every billed shift with date, start time, end time, duration, and the hourly rate if printed, plus the invoice total. Schema: an array of shifts with date, start, end, duration, hourly_rate; plus total.

Use ug-surveillance event-timeline on camera-id Front Door (the Front Door camera), start-time 2026-11-03T00:00, end-time 2026-11-07T00:00, timezone America/New_York, topic HumanFace, identity-type known, person-name Grace Mensah, limit 200. The household has confirmed the cameras recognise faces and may be used to check hours, so this is approved. Return every event with its timestamp, camera, topic and identity.
